name: taskbelay-codex
description: TaskBelay tasks in local branches or dedicated worktrees for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Assess development requests before choosing direct work or TaskBelay. Default to a new task branch in the current directory; explicitly choose the current branch or a dedicated worktree when needed. Preserve confirmed initial content and resume the same Core Task in its original directory. The $taskbelay-codex:taskbelay selector does not skip assessment.
defaultPrompt: $taskbelay-codex:taskbelay assess the requested change in this repository before starting TaskBelay.
